reconciliation_with_prior_reference_evid.P2E07: Prior Reference-only evidence showed many strict local-balance rate failures can lie at or below a diagnosed finite-representation/cancellation floor even when integrated residual depth is about 1e-16 to 1e-15 cm.
reconciliation_with_prior_reference_evid.P2E08: Six anchor materials had one complete common Reference level at coarse dt 0.0064 day; the 30-material extension does not.
reconciliation_with_prior_reference_evid.implication: The current boolean Reference validity gate is insufficient to classify the persistent extension failures as physical/nonlinear failure versus numerically indistinguishable local-balance-rate failure. Failure-reason diagnostics are required before narrowing the material domain.
